name: Prayer Intercessory
overview: The sample verses from Genesis 17 and 18 reveal intercessory prayer as a bold and intimate dialogue between Abraham and God, where Abraham appeals for mercy on behalf of others, such as Ishmael and the righteous in Sodom. Abraham’s approach demonstrates a deep concern for justice and compassion, confidently presenting petitions to God while acknowledging his own humility. This example sets a foundational pattern for believers to intercede with faith and reverence, trusting in God’s righteous judgment and willingness to respond to the prayers of His people.
